title: Cardano ledger peer snapshot
description: JSON peer snapshot used by cardano-node (`peerSnapshotFile` / big-ledger peers) and embedded by Amaru at build time. Compatible with files under cardano-foundation/cardano-configurations (`network/<name>/cardano-node/peer-snapshot.json`).

NetworkMagic.description: Cardano network magic (protocol magic). Common values: mainnet 764824073, preprod 1, preview 2.

NodeToClientVersion.description: Node-to-client protocol version recorded when the snapshot was produced.

bigLedgerPools.description: Big-ledger stake pools and their public relays. May be empty for offline placeholder files.

blockPointHash.description: Header hash of the snapshot tip as 32-byte hex (64 hex characters).

accumulatedStake.description: Optional cumulative relative stake (present in cardano-node exports; ignored by Amaru).

relativeStake.description: Optional pool relative stake (present in cardano-node exports; ignored by Amaru).

address.description: DNS name or IP address of the relay.

port.description: TCP port. When omitted, Amaru defaults to 3001.
